nodes.label: Pre-order as out-of-stock selling behavior, not publishing concept
nodes.author: Damian (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: An earlier draft gated pre-order on a future published_at, excluding the common live-restock case; decoupling pre-order from publishing fixes both concerns — visibility and out-of-stock behavior are independent switches.

nodes.label: backorder_limit universal oversell cap
nodes.author: Damian (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: One integer bounds overselling for both backorder and pre-order (empty = unlimited); pre-order is backorder-with-a-delivery-promise so the two share one cap, enforced solely in Quantifier#can_supply?.
